messages:
Nina: Heads-up for folks in NY office tomorrow 1st street block market is back 17:00pm. Thinking if we want to meet after demos? street food vs. sushi counter upstairs? vote with :ramen: or :sushi:
Omar: Street market for me 10/10 for bao and weird fried things.
Jules: Sushi counter has great omakase specials on Thursdays, but it's pricier. Any budget constraints?
Kai: I'm broke but willing to splurge once a month lol. :cry: Sushi if others want it.
Rina: Vegans? I need recs that aren't just fries. Market usually has a good tofu skewer stall.
foodie-bot: Poll made 187: react :ramen: for market, :sushi: for sushi counter. Poll link: https://polls.example/1870001111
Sam: :ramen: (if there is that grilled corn stall pls)
Omar: :ramen:
Nina: :sushi: (I miss fresh sashimi tbh)
Jules: :sushi: but can we do split-pay so no one covers a huge tab?
Kai: We can use SplitPay app, or I can Venmo my share to whoever pays initial.
Rina: Does sushi have gluten-free soy sauce? I can bring tamari but would rather they have options.
Nina: I'll call the sushi counter around 4pm to check GF options and reserve a 6:45 spot if we pick sushi.
Sam: If market wins, can we coordinate on cash vs card? Some stalls are cash-only.
Omar: I can bring small bills. Also, pro tip: try the chili honey lobster roll at stall #5, it's worth the lines.
Jules: OK poll looks close. If sushi wins I'll book, if market wins we meet at the north entrance at 6:30.
foodie-bot: Reminder set for poll close at 5:30pm.
Nina: Final tally: market 4, sushi 3. Market wins. Meeting: north entrance 6:30, bring $10-$20 cash for quick buys.
Kai: Any volunteers to organize a quick map of stalls? I can do a Google Pin list.
Omar: I'll photo the stall menu items so vegans know choices.
Rina: Thanks! Also, can we agree not to double-queue? Last time was chaos. :sweat_smile:
Nina: Agreed. One person orders per stall, we'll split up to reduce wait.
Jules: If someone's late, take leftovers home 1% chance I'll steal your bao.
Sam: lol noted. Thanks for organizing Nina & Omar.
Nina: No prob. See you all there f37a (foodie emoji)
